name: lottie
title: Lottie
responsibility: Reusable animation assets — designer-authored JSON animations played as part of the design. Animation as an ASSET, not code.
reachFor: Marketing animations that play as assets (no interaction needed)
avoid: Animations needing interaction/state — Rive state machines (see rive/)
Everything achievable in CSS/SVG — a runtime JSON player is heavier than keyframes
Shipping multiple huge JSONs per preset — keep assets tiny
reactWiring: useLottie({ animationData }) or <Lottie autoplay loop path>; assets under src/assets, lazy-loaded
